description: We are AgriSpace Innovators, a student-led team developing AgriSpace Ethiopia, an AI-powered agricultural platform using NASA satellite data and Earth observation resources. Our mission is to help farmers monitor crop health, identify potential pests and plant diseases, understand weather conditions, and make better farming decisions. We welcome developers, AI enthusiasts, agriculture experts, designers, and creative problem-solvers from around the world.
summary:
AgriSpace Ethiopia is a global smart-farming web platform developed to help farmers make better agricultural decisions using NASA Earth observation data. It integrates NASA POWER daily weather information and NASA GIBS satellite imagery to help users explore rainfall, temperature, humidity, solar radiation, vegetation conditions, and land surface temperature.

Farmers can select locations worldwide, explore satellite layers, draw farm boundaries, monitor weather trends, calculate irrigation and rainwater needs, and record crop observations. The platform also provides a plant-photo reporting tool, agricultural decision support, and multilingual access in English, Afaan Oromoo, and Amharic.

AgriSpace addresses the challenges of climate uncertainty, water management, and limited access to agricultural information. Its goal is to make Earth observation technology more accessible and useful for farmers in Ethiopia and around the world.
details:
AgriSpace is a responsive, browser-based agricultural decision-support platform designed for farmers worldwide, with a focus on Ethiopia.

How it works

  1. Farmers select their location using GPS, place-name search, or coordinates.
  2. The application retrieves daily weather observations from the NASA POWER API, including precipitation, temperature, humidity, and solar radiation.
  3. NASA GIBS provides satellite imagery layers, including MODIS vegetation index, true-color imagery, and land surface temperature.
  4. Users can draw or import farm boundaries, explore weather patterns, calculate growing degree days and water balance, and export field information.
  5. The Plant Photo Check tool allows farmers to preview crop photographs, record visible symptoms, and prepare field observation reports.

Benefits and Impact

AgriSpace helps farmers understand environmental conditions, plan water use, organize field observations, and access Earth observation information. It is designed for global use and supports English, Afaan Oromoo, and Amharic.

Technology

  • HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript
  • NASA POWER Daily API
  • NASA GIBS WMTS satellite imagery
  • Leaflet interactive mapping
  • Chart.js data visualization
  • OpenStreetMap Nominatim place search
  • Esri satellite and topographic basemaps
  • Browser local storage and CSV/GeoJSON exports

Creativity and Scientific Responsibility

The project combines satellite observations, agricultural calculations, interactive mapping, and multilingual accessibility in one platform. It distinguishes real NASA observations from illustrative boundaries and exploratory calculations.

AI tools assisted with ideation, coding, debugging, writing, and visual design. The current plant-photo feature does not contain a trained disease-classification model, and the agricultural assistant uses local rules rather than an external AI model.

Developer: Olyad
